prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1100; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you the facts. I'm the driver of the silver sedan that was involved.

Q: Understood. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was backing out of a space near the store entrance. It was late afternoon and the lot was pretty busy.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before contact?

A: Not right away. I checked my mirrors and didn't see anything behind me. Then I felt a bump and heard a crunch on the driver's side rear.

Q: Were you moving when the impact occurred?

A: Yes, I was rolling backward slowly, maybe a few miles an hour.

Q: Did you stop your vehicle immediately after the contact?

A: Yes. I put it in park and got out to look.

Q: Have you noticed any injuries since the collision?

A: My neck is sore. It's a stiff, tight feeling in the back and sides, and turning my head to the left hurts. I've been taking over-the-counter pain relief.

Q: Have you sought medical care?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same evening. They told me it looked like a neck strain and gave me instructions to rest and do gentle stretches.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?

A: Yes, it's improved a little but I still have discomfort when I turn my head or sit for long periods.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm willing to provide the clinic paperwork if you need it.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
